Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 7 October 2026

1. Who We Are

This Privacy Policy applies to PT PatuhData Solusi Nusantara ("PatuhData," "we," "us," or "our"), a registered PT PMDN entity in Indonesia, operating the website at patuhdata.id and all associated services.

Contact: hello@patuhdata.id | +62 819 0337 8000 | Jakarta, Indonesia

2. Data We Collect

We collect personal data in the following circumstances:

  • Consultation forms: Name, company, role, business email, WhatsApp number, organization details, interests, timeline, and message.
  • Free resource requests: Name, company, and business email, together with the resources requested.
  • Consent records: A random consent ID, timestamp, policy version, consent method, and selected cookie categories. Browser-side consent records do not intentionally contain your name or email.
  • Analytics: If you accept optional analytics cookies, we collect anonymised usage data (pages visited, session duration, browser type) via analytics tooling. No personally identifiable information is collected through analytics.
  • Email correspondence: If you contact us by email, we retain the content of that correspondence and your email address.

We do not collect payment card information, government identification numbers, or sensitive personal data (as defined under UU PDP Pasal 4) through this website.

3. Legal Basis for Processing

Under UU PDP No. 27/2022, we process your personal data on the following legal bases:

  • Consent (Pasal 20): For analytics cookies, you provide explicit consent through the cookie consent mechanism on this website.
  • Legitimate interest (Pasal 20): For contact form submissions, we process your data to respond to your inquiry — a legitimate interest that does not override your rights.
  • Contractual necessity: For clients who engage PatuhData services, processing is necessary to fulfill the service agreement.

4. How We Use Your Data

  • To respond to your consultation inquiry or service request
  • To provide requested templates and relevant follow-up
  • To provide and manage the services you have engaged
  • To send service-related communications (not marketing without consent)
  • To improve our website and services (anonymised analytics only)
  • To comply with our legal obligations under Indonesian law

5. Data Retention

Inquiry, resource-request, and email data may be retained for up to 3 years from the last meaningful interaction, unless a longer period is required for an engagement or legal obligation. The consent cookie is retained for up to 1 year, and browser-side history stores the most recent 20 consent decisions. Analytics data follows the configured provider retention settings.

6. Data Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. We may share data with:

  • Service providers: Vercel hosts the website, Web3Forms processes submitted forms, and Google Analytics processes usage information only after analytics consent.
  • Legal requirement: Indonesian regulatory authorities (including the personal data protection authority, Komdigi, or law enforcement) if required by applicable law.

7. Your Rights Under UU PDP

Under UU PDP No. 27/2022, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

  • Right to information (Pasal 5): Know who processes your personal data, for what purpose, and on what basis.
  • Right to correction (Pasal 6): Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Right to access (Pasal 7): Request access to and a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Right to end processing and deletion (Pasal 8): Request that we stop processing, delete, or destroy your personal data.
  • Right to withdraw consent (Pasal 9): Withdraw consent at any time where consent is the legal basis for processing.
  • Right to restrict processing (Pasal 11): Request that processing be delayed or limited.
  • Right to data portability (Pasal 13): Obtain your personal data in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

To exercise these rights, contact privacy@patuhdata.id. We will verify and respond within the period required by applicable law.

8. Cookies

We use essential storage for site functionality and consent evidence. Optional analytics cookies remain disabled until consent. Reopen the preference center through “Cookie Settings.” See our Cookie Policy.

9. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction — including TLS encryption for data in transit, access controls, and regular security reviews.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version is always available at patuhdata.id/privacy with its effective date.

11. Contact & Complaints

For privacy inquiries: privacy@patuhdata.id

If you are not satisfied with our response, you may lodge a complaint with the personal data protection authority established under UU PDP No. 27/2022.
